name: dsql
description: This is an interface reference for Amazon Aurora DSQL.

subcommands.name: create-cluster
subcommands.description: The CreateCluster API allows you to create both single-Region clusters and multi-Region clusters.

subcommands.name: create-stream
subcommands.description: Creates a new change data capture (CDC) stream for a cluster.

subcommands.name: delete-cluster
subcommands.description: Deletes a cluster in Amazon Aurora DSQL.

subcommands.name: delete-cluster-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource-based policy attached to a cluster.

subcommands.name: delete-stream
subcommands.description: Deletes a stream from a cluster.

subcommands.name: get-cluster
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a cluster.

subcommands.name: get-cluster-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resource-based policy document attached to a cluster.

subcommands.name: get-stream
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a stream.

subcommands.name: get-vpc-endpoint-service-name
subcommands.description: Retrieves the VPC endpoint service name.

subcommands.name: list-clusters
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a list of clusters.

subcommands.name: list-streams
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a list of streams for a cluster.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all of the tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: put-cluster-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches a resource-based policy to a cluster.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tags a resource with a map of key and value pairs.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-cluster
subcommands.description: The UpdateCluster API allows you to modify both single-Region and multi-Region cluster configurations.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: cluster-active
subcommands.description: Wait until a Cluster is ACTIVE It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: cluster-not-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until a Cluster is gone It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: stream-active
subcommands.description: Wait until a Stream is ACTIVE It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: stream-not-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until a Stream is gone It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.
